error[ZBX-E0558]: the password file or input is unsafe or unusable
  while  reading the password for a push
  cause  /open can be read by other users
  path   /open
  fix    make it private to you:   chmod 600 /open
  more   zbx explain E0558
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0558.html
